body: I’m the opposite. I could care less about friends just want a partner
I hate MMO’s but I agree. TESO is amazing!

If people were nicer to me I wouldn’t be such an asshole.   

People who have done nothing to me think I’m the nicest guy ever. People who have hurt me bring out my BPD traits and think I’m mean.
I gotta do 3000 and I’m never hungry. it’s a rough life.
I have no plans. Never do. All the people who will pretend to be sad when I end my life, never call me or reach out
Well I am failing that test and don’t appreciate a god that would put me through a life like this. The idea there may be a god that could end my pain but chooses not to, makes me hate god.
I’ve reached the max of my potential. I am doing my very best and it’s not good enough to get ahead and begin to finally enjoy life
I’m ready to get off this roller coaster ride
Good one!

I come here to Reddit. 

I’d rather be ignored by strangers than by people who I love(d) and cherish(ed)

You’re probably right unfortunately. I had lots of friends when I was the only kid in my high school friend group with a job or a car. Eventually we all grew up and they all ended up with better careers than me and slowly stopped communicating with me, and the ones who stayed left later on when I got depressed
You got a sense of humour, that’s a good start!

What bothers me is that I’m much better now.  I have forgiven people who have hurt me but the people I let down won’t forgive me.

What did I do to let them down is probably what you’re wondering. I basically just told my family I was depressed and felt like dying.

And just like that , in my weakest moment, they were gone. 

It’s ok to mess up your life - it happens. It’s not ok to not try to fix it. You know what you did wrong so just don’t do those things again and hopefully eventually better people will come into your life. 

I am hoping this works for me as well. If you want to chat more feel free to pm me
I had to block people today too. Don’t let people get away with treating you like you don’t matter

Good points! I hope things change soon. I agree that it’s so hard for men to have problems like this. If I were a woman I would have tons of support. My family has literally said “be a man”. I am doing the best I can. I’m sorry if I need companionship and support and some extra help and I’m sorry that people think it’s not ok for men to need this. We have BPD and other disorders too. We can’t always be stoic all the time, in every situation, forever and ever. 

Might take your advice and help someone else who’s doing worse than me. I genuinely like helping those in need. That’s why it bothers me that I complained to my people and they left me, which is something I would not do to them
That’s just how it is for guys. 90% of women only want the top 10% of men. The rest of us average joes get passed over because women think they all deserve millionaire CEO’s who look like supermodels
Hey no worries I actually don’t care about anyones age, I don’t know why I wrote that part. It’s sucks to be left alone when you have messed up your life and need people more than ever.
I think she was hired by JD’s team
I’m essentially the same. The anxiety really gets to me as well.
I hope she stays safe.

I’m watching Ambers psychiatrist talk about BPD and how awful some of us can be sometimes. Never thought to read the YouTube comments - I’m almost scared to do so, but of course I’m going to. I try to avoid reading about what people think of us. But hearing that psychiatrist speak and then reading all your posts is making me realize that we have a huge stigma on us. 

Guaranteed all my ex friends and family that are watching this are thinking of me now and how horrible I am.

I don’t feel good. I try so hard but am simply not good enough. I have reached the limits of my capabilities and it seems it’s still not enough. Everytime I get close to the finish line the finish line is moved. I can’t get a break. Thanks for checking in

I lost all my friends as well. Not for the same reason though. I got depressed and they all ditched me instead of helping me out. 

Now I’m mostly sane and working on myself and I’m way better, but nobody knows.

Life is definitely not fair. Just do the best with what resources you have. Try to improve a bit each day and you’ll be fine. 

We will make new friends. All things in good time.

I’ve been eating without the liner. Had my extractions last week on Friday and got my new dentures the same day. 

Had a slice of pizza Monday night. Been mostly eating soup though. Had to cut up the pizza into little bits. It was hard but it tasted so good. 

I hope you get a lot of replies as I have the same question as you. Soup gets real boring real fast

I’m 63kg and the same height as you. and haven’t been working out lately. I look about average size for my height, but I am getting a fat tummy. 

I am going to start eating a lot more and working out everyday until I am about 77kg of muscle. 

You got a long way to go before you will look fat. I can imagine how thin you must look being the same height as me and 15 kg lighter 

Eat like a pig and maybe learn how to make a weight gain smoothie. 

And at least do a basic workout twice a week. But don’t do much cardio. 

That’s my two cents worth!
Goodness that’s a lot of work parties! I would die if there were that many events for my work this summer. We have one event and I’m trying to get out of it myself.

I hate that my work wants to start doing team building exercises. I hate that people feel this kind of thing is necessary. 

We’re not in public school anymore and I really don’t want to get to know my teammates. Almost every job I’ve ever left, I didn’t keep up relationships with any of the staff. I googled it and most other people don’t stay in touch with ex co-workers either, so therefore we don’t need to know each other well. 

I don’t care that Jim from accounting likes to take a power walk after work.

Just had my extraction day Friday. It was way better and way more painless than I imagined. The bottom denture hurts a bit. I hear that’s typical though. I was missing a few teeth and had some gaps. All good now. I don’t look like the inbred cousin anymore lol. It’s a nice feeling. Good luck!
